notes: Baseline: default k8s-HPA controller (target 50% cpu, 15s sync, 15s metric window, 30s readiness delay, 120s boot) under a clean step from 100 to 400 rps. Unit pinned to the classic reference shape the rest of the deck quotes: 16 cores, 100 ms of CPU per request, no I/O, no queue -> 16 workers, a pure loss system (M/D/16/16, Erlang-B), 160 rps/instance, so 400 rps needs 5 at 50%. Scales 2 -> 4 -> 6 (seed 2: 2 -> 4 -> 5) with no overshoot and ~2.1% errors (seeds 1-3 alike), all of it in the boot-window dead time right after the step, none of it the controller's fault. This is the well-behaved reference case everything else in the deck is compared against.
